assertions.title: WSL distro list single-flight single-flights concurrent asynchronous discovery
WSL distro list single-flight single-flights a concurrent empty result without hiding a distro installed later
WSL distro list single-flight single-flights a concurrent failure and keeps the retry window bounded
WSL distro list single-flight lets a caller joining a pending probe see a distro the sync empty result hid
WSL distro list single-flight returns a list found synchronously without waiting on the pending probe
WSL distro list single-flight does not let an older async empty result overwrite a newer sync list
WSL distro list single-flight does not let an older async different list result overwrite a newer sync list
WSL distro list single-flight does not let a probe retired by a cache reset clear the new in-flight slot
WSL distro list single-flight holds the base window when a sync empty result and an async failure overlap
running WSL distro discovery lists only running user distros without starting them
running WSL distro discovery fails closed when running-distro discovery fails
running WSL distro discovery resolves homes only for the running distro set
running WSL distro discovery single-flights concurrent probes without caching the result
running WSL distro discovery single-flights cold HOME probes across concurrent callers
running WSL distro discovery filters stopped-distro UNC paths while preserving host paths
running WSL distro discovery does not probe WSL on non-Windows hosts
running WSL distro discovery keeps reporting a session running through a sustained wsl.exe outage, without unbounded spawns
